idea-plugin.name: Jeels Json to Dart
idea-plugin.description:
Generate Dart model classes instantly from pasted JSON.

Right-click any folder → New → Jeels JSON to Dart, paste your JSON, and get clean, null-safe Dart model classes with fromJson / toJson methods — including full support for nested objects, arrays, and snake_case to camelCase conversion.

No more writing boilerplate model classes by hand.

action.description: Generate a Dart model file from pasted JSON
